display.purpose: Hero name line and H1, the splash wordmark, and small UI chrome (nav links, buttons, pills). H1 is 900 in Royal Purple.

wordmark.purpose: Both wordmarks, so the header and footer read as one object. Navbar DEVOMB.COM at text-fluid-sm; footer DEVOM at clamp(2.1rem, 12.7vw, 15.7rem) sized by glyph measurement to span ~58vw. Weight 800, font-variation-settings "wdth" 125, Royal Purple Lift in the footer, Ink in the navbar.

page-title.purpose: H1 and section h2 on project, demo, and legal pages. Never on the home page, which has no large headings.

title.purpose: Row names — job titles, project names, school names. 13px semibold; where most of the home page's sans text lives.

body.purpose: Bio paragraphs, taglines, project descriptions, legal prose. Muted colour, 62ch measure. The default on <body>.

label.purpose: Section identifiers (// experience) in Joker Green; dates, chips, footer links, the navbar clock, terminal output, row indices in Muted. Every numeral on the site is mono with tabular-nums. The only monospace.

extensions.typographyStatus: Decided 2026-09-03 in the font lab (since deleted). Five families, one per role, declared in src/app/layout.tsx and mapped in tailwind.config.js. A sixth family (IBM Plex Mono for the // labels) was rejected: one monospace for everything.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Floating or windowed objects only — the mobile nav drawer, the 404 terminal, .card-soft. Never on rows or sections.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Defined in tailwind.config.js; not used by any current component.

shadows.name: glow
shadows.purpose: Green focus ring token. Reserved for interactive focus states.

motion.name: ease-snappy
motion.purpose: Default easing for section fade-ins and state transitions.

motion.name: duration-standard
motion.purpose: Section fade-in on scroll, once per element (viewport once: true).

motion.name: splash
motion.purpose: The card-deal loading screen. Skipped on client-side navigation. Skip hint reads CLICK TO SKIP on pointer devices and TAP TO SKIP on touch via a (hover: none) and (pointer: coarse) media query.

brandMark.name: The fan
brandMark.description: Two playing cards mid-deal — back card rotated -18deg, front card +7deg, front carrying a D and a Joker Green diamond pip. Purple strokes on near-black faces.
sources: src/app/mark.tsx (same geometry as JSX for next/og — apple-icon.tsx, opengraph-image.tsx, twitter-image.tsx)
brandMark.rule: Change icon.svg and src/app/mark.tsx together. Never redraw per surface.

knownPitfalls.name: Translucent tokens take no alpha modifier
knownPitfalls.body: border, accent-bg and secondary-bg are already rgb(... / a) values, so border-border/50 or bg-accent-bg/40 would not resolve. Every other token is channel-based and accepts /opacity. Fixed 2026-09-04; before that the modifier emitted no CSS on any token.

narrative.overview:
The site is a poker table after dark: a black felt canvas, one purple light, one green signal, and cards as the only physical objects. It reads two ways at once. Anyone gets the surface — big name, clear rows, direct copy. A developer gets the substrate: // section labels set as code comments, a server log that types itself in on load, SQL ghost text in the hero, a fake shell for the 404, a splash that deals cards before the page appears.

Precision-document structure, not marketing-page structure: rows over card grids, hairline dividers over fills, type scale over decoration. The single loud gesture is permitted — the hero H1 and the footer wordmark are huge — and everything else stays quiet so that gesture lands.
keyCharacteristics: Black is the canvas, never a dark mode of something lighter
Two hues, each with one job: purple is structure, green is signal
Five type families, one job each: Plex Sans for content, Bricolage for the hero and chrome, Space Grotesk for inner-page titles, Geist Mono for all data, Anybody for the wordmark
The deck is the brand: favicon, Apple icon, OG card, and splash all use the fan mark
Reticent interaction: nothing moves until you act, then it moves briefly

rules.name: The Two-Hue Rule
rules.body: Royal Purple and Joker Green are the palette. No third hue. Tonal variation steps a hue toward black or uses alpha over black.

rules.name: Purple is structure, green is signal
rules.body: Purple marks what holds the page up — headings, borders, the wordmark, actions. Green marks what is live or labelled — status dots, section identifiers, a successful log line, the pip on the mark. Green on a heading is wrong. The one shared use is a terminal chrome strip, where red/yellow/green are quoting a window control, not signalling state.

rules.name: Alpha is a modifier
rules.body: Solid tokens are defined by RGB channels and mapped with <alpha-value>, so text-muted/60 and bg-bg/90 emit real CSS. border, accent-bg and secondary-bg are already translucent and take no modifier. Change a colour by editing its *-rgb line in globals.css.

rules.name: Mono = data
rules.body: Dates, stack items, code, terminal lines, indices, section identifiers, the URL — Geist Mono, and only Geist Mono; numerals tabular. Names, titles, sentences — a sans chosen by role: Plex Sans for content, Bricolage for chrome, Space Grotesk for inner-page titles.

rules.name: One heading per section
rules.body: A section is titled by its // label or a heading, never both saying the same thing. Home sections use the label only and have no large headings at all.

rules.name: Flat by default
rules.body: Depth comes from surface → surface-elevated steps and purple hairlines. shadow-card is permitted on floating or windowed objects (the nav drawer, the 404 terminal), never on rows or sections.

rules.name: The Opacity Rule
rules.body: Linked rows fade to opacity 0.7 on hover. No scale, no lift, no fill. Text links shift colour.

dos: Do edit colours only in the three --brand-* tokens in src/app/globals.css; everything else derives from them.
Do use the /opacity modifier on solid tokens (text-muted/60, bg-bg/90); reach for opacity-* only when the whole element should fade.
Do keep purple for structure and green for signal.
Do put content in rows with hairlines, not in cards.
Do set every number in mono with tabular-nums so columns align.
Do use the fan mark from its two sources (src/app/icon.svg, src/app/mark.tsx); never a per-surface redraw.
Do keep the loud gestures to two: the hero H1 and the footer wordmark.
Do judge type decisions at 11–13px, where the site actually lives.
Do pick the sans by role, not by taste: content in font-sans (Plex), chrome in font-display (Bricolage), inner-page titles in font-title (Space Grotesk).
donts: Don't describe the site as dark mode. There is no light mode; black is the canvas.
Don't hardcode hex in components. Use var(--color-*) or the Tailwind token names. The next/og image files are the one exception and mirror the tokens in a comment.
Don't introduce a third hue, a sixth type family or a second monospace, or a shadow on a resting row.
Don't add motion that runs without the user: no loops, no scroll-jacking, no continuous movement. Load once, respond to hover and focus.
Don't build icon + heading + text card grids, side-stripe accents, gradient text, hero metrics, testimonial carousels, or gradient blobs.
Don't give a section both a // label and a heading saying the same thing.
Don't reintroduce the retired contact section, the server-online widget, or the footer timestamp; the footer is links, copyright, wordmark.
